item.title: Re: -1 :(
item.content:encoded:
I agree, the wording is rather strange, it doesn't sound like clinical tone and there are a couple unclear sentences present in the page like:

Strange grammar and tonal usage examples
It is based on my opinion though

Due to the classmates and civilian around SCP-5418 that witnessed its reality-bending ability, they had been tracked and administered Class-A amnestic.

So civilian as in singular? So like there was this one dude on the street watching 5418 and his school buddies and no one else (that's not a student) was there? And why use "had" for the plural pronoun "they"

During its pursuit, SCP-5418 landed on top of the Mountain Bogd, deformed the bird and sunk itself into the Mountain afterwards.

"Deformed the bird" is a rather strange part to the sentence, I advice adding "it" after the comma

Between 8 am to 8 pm, there was no activity. However, at 9 pm, the ground shook in minor 10 decibels until a cave's entry point had formed on the mountain's skirt.

I'm no scientist but aren't decibels used to measure sound?

Albeit the tracking device placed within SCP-5418’s hand had worked significantly less than as expected, the only way to track the subject is when it's inactive during the nights.

Albeit is rather strange to use, though that is just personal preference. "nights" is usually used for referencing multiple nights though "during the night" makes much more sense

The story and scp overall is fine, just needs polish and a couple of more revisions

edit1: attempt at using fancy stuff
edit2: fancy stuff failed

Downvoted. Sorry :(

In my opinion, this needs to be looked over once more. There's a lot of glaring SPAG errors as well as poorly phrased sentencing and unclincal tone.

For instance:

Special Containment Procedure Updated

Flows badly: Updated Special Containment Procedures flows better.

introduces itself as Oulen.

Flows badly: I would put the first sentence as two things - "SCP-5418 is a seventeen-year-old male humanoid of Mongolian descent." then "SCP-5418 refers to itself as Oulen".

As of now, It needs a polish and a round of critique before posting imo.

-1
